description: Sri Lanka Customs - Rates of Exchange with effective from 06.06.2022 to 12.06.2022
reasoning: This gazette notification is issued by the Director General of Customs under the authority of the Customs Ordinance (Chapter 235). It establishes new rates of exchange for calculating customs duties and other charges, which constitutes a regulatory framework for customs operations. The content involves legal/regulatory matters rather than government personnel changes, organizational structure, or any of the other specialized categories.
